Coram:

Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar For the Petitioner : Mr.
Durga C. Mishra, Advocate For the Resp.-State : Mrs. Omiya Anusha, A.C. to A.A.G-Ia For the Resp.

The writ petition has been filed for the following relief(s):
"For issuance of an appropriate writ(s), for quashing the letter no. 8 dated 07.01.2025 (Annexure-7) issued under the signature of respondent no.3 (Special Land Acquisition Officer, Medium Irrigation Project, Deoghar), whereby and whereunder the respondent no.3 directed the petitioners to appear before the court with regard to objection raised by the private respondent nos. 5 to 17 in relation to Mouza Madransa, Thana No.4, Khata No. 36, Khesra No. 295 and Khata No. 37,
Khesra Nos. 400, 398 and 271, area 1.10 acres, amounting to Rs. 44,84,366/-, as the petitioners have received the payment of compensation through the Award.

And The petitioners further pray that during the pendency of the present writ petition, stay the operation / implementation of letter no. 8 dated 07.01.2025 (Annexure-7) issued under the signature of respondent no.3 (Special Land Acquisition Officer, Medium Irrigation Project, Deoghar)."
2.

It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the respondent- State that some dispute has been raised and the matter has been referred to the concerned authority under Section 64 of the Land Acquisition Act.

3. In that view of the matter, the present writ petition is disposed of with a liberty to the parties to raise all the objections in the pending reference case before the Principal District Judge, Dumka.
